verbalization: Rel-Camellioside F appears to have a shared target, HCT-15, which is also the target of two different compounds: (2R,3S,5R)-2,3-Epoxy-6,9-Humuladien-5-Ol-8-One and Ochratoxin alpha. This suggests that Rel-Camellioside F may act through a common mechanism or pathway that leads to the activation of HCT-15, which in turn targets LS174T. The evidence indicates that Rel-Camellioside F may exert its effects by modulating HCT-15, potentially through a direct or indirect interaction that results in the activation of the downstream target LS174T. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Rel-Camellioside F in influencing HCT-15 activity, which could have implications for the biological processes underlying LS174T function. The relationship is supported by the observed target hierarchy, suggesting a potential mechanism of action that involves HCT-15 as a central mediator.
